upgradeAndRollback.installerReason: install-ec2.sh refuses an active service, refuses changing the current release symlink, and refuses overwriting a different runtime release in runtime.env. Never rerun bootstrap/--init to upgrade.
upgradeAndRollback.documentedControls: Use the existing owner-only control socket as the runtime user; status/pause/resume/safe-stop forms are in RUNBOOK.md. Installed main-symlink flag is a completed fix, not another action.
upgradeAndRollback.oldCodeRollback: Monetary schema is readable in source, but bce3d22 ignores newer cost/no-reentry semantics and cannot manage positions/pending sells. Only an entries-disabled, exposure-free observer fallback is supportable; never roll back newer financial records.
upgradeAndRollback.requiredBeforeAnyFutureAuthorizedSwitch: Freeze exact tested SHA; keep original DB/account/inception and reporting identity; make and validate a consistent current SQLite backup, prove disposable restore and cross-version reopen; stop only through safe ownership release, preserve the old immutable release and installed credential/drop-in boundaries, and review an explicit atomic switch/reversal plan. No such actions were executed.

npm run account -- restore --db NEW_PRIVATE_DB --account EXISTING_ACCOUNT --input VERIFIED_BACKUP
backupRestoreCommandReview.preconditions: Offline CLI opens the financial writer lease; do not run it against an active authoritative account. Use the existing sole writer backup API for an online copy.
backupRestoreCommandReview.restoreBehavior: Requires a new target; verifies source integrity and account/mode, reopens through current ledger validation and appends an entries-closed pause. It retains source inception, rather than starting new capital.
backupRestoreCommandReview.inceptionCaveat: CLI has no expected-inception flag. Independently compare backup/restored inception against the verified expected identity; FinancialBackupStore inspection takes and checks that expected identity.
backupRestoreCommandReview.historyCaveat: Never restore an older snapshot over newer actions merely to roll code back. Preserve newer source/WAL/uncertainty and reconcile.

beforeIsolatedEc2Shadow: Freeze a tested source/build SHA and a specific read-only shadow entrypoint. Keep the existing observer, service, DB path, account/inception and Render publisher untouched; shadow must have separate output and no production credential/financial/reporting bindings.

Through existing authorized access, verify current capacity and nonroot execution plus process-level CPU/RSS/FD/disk/network budgets. Cloud results do not establish EC2 resource compatibility. No shadow launcher/resource compatibility was demonstrated by this review.
